If the raw value for an integer-valued property is not an integer,
warn and discard the value.

-- test.glx --
places:
    someplace:
        name: Someplace
        type: county
        properties:
            # population is an integer property.
            population: "string instead of integer"

-- want-error --
places\[someplace\].Properties.population: value discarded: expected integer, got string
places\[someplace\].Properties.population: entry discarded: has neither value nor fields
places\[someplace\].Properties.population: property discarded: no entries

-- want-catalog.yaml --
places:
    someplace:
        type:
            definition:
                label: County
            value: county
        properties: {}
